Anders Møller Schlünsen is a clinical epidemiologist holding a PhD, who has played a significant role in the governance and data management of cardiovascular quality improvement initiatives in Denmark. He is primarily known for his work with the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database), where he has served as a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] (AFDK Steering Committee) [^src1] [^src2]. 

Initially documented in the 2023 and 2024 annual reports as being affiliated with the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1] [^src2], his institutional alignment transitioned by the 2025 reporting period. In the 2025 AFDK annual report, Schlünsen is listed as an epidemiologist working for [[sundhedsvaesenets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]] (SundK) [^src3] [^src4]. Furthermore, he acts as the primary contact person and representative for the [[data-responsible-authority|data-responsible-authority]] regarding the database's data processing and governance [^src4]. His ongoing involvement underscores the cross-sectoral and interdisciplinary nature of the AFDK's efforts to monitor and improve treatment quality for atrial fibrillation patients across the Danish healthcare system.
